profile.headline: Founder and Principal Engineer at AM2TECH LLC
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack software engineer with 20+ years of experience designing and shipping enterprise systems in Java/Spring Boot and Angular across foodservice, retail, e-commerce, payments, government healthcare, and defense.
What I bring:
- An eye for UX – I build reusable foundations that make the right experience the default. My BossTable component replaced one-off table builds across 170+ screens at Buyers Edge Platform.
- Advanced problem solving – from a brand-new accounts payable and bank reconciliation system to a payment consolidation system saving ~$200K/year, I turn complex domains into reliable, intuitive software.
- Fast learning and fast delivery – I ramp quickly in new domains and codebases. I shipped bank-reconciliation-to-invoice matching in 2–3 days against a 3-week estimate, with full backend test coverage.
- AI-assisted engineering – I use Claude and GitHub Copilot for planning, implementation, and multi-pass code review, and I've shipped LLM features in production.
- Leadership – I've mentored junior developers and interns, set UI component standards, and led cross-functional teams.
Outside my day job I run AM2TECH LLC, where I designed, built, and operate BroomBook (broombook.app), a multi-tenant SaaS platform for curling clubs with native iOS/Android apps, Stripe Connect payments, offline-first scoring, and AI-powered scoreboard reading.
Eagle Scout. CodeMash speaker.
I'm looking for a senior, staff, principal, or team lead role (remote or hybrid, open to travel). Let's connect.

positions.title: Founder and Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Software development and technology consulting. I run the business end to end: client discovery, estimates, architecture, development, cloud hosting, and support.
BroomBook (broombook.app) – multi-tenant SaaS platform for curling clubs
- Designed, built, and operate a full web platform plus native iOS/Android apps for leagues, bonspiels, live scoring, subs, waivers, payments, and club websites
- Integrated the Anthropic Claude vision API to read a photo of a club's scoreboard and auto-fill end-by-end scores
- Built offline-first mobile scoring that works with no signal and syncs when the connection returns
- Implemented Stripe Connect so fees go straight to each club's own account, with platform fees, refunds, and reporting
- Built a schedule generator balancing draw times, days, and sheets; playoff brackets with projected seeds; configurable tiebreakers
- Automated waitlists, reminders, push/SMS notifications, calendar feeds, email-to-news publishing, and signed PDF waivers
- Sign-in via email/SMS (Resend, Twilio), multi-club dashboards, family accounts, custom roles
Stack: Angular, TypeScript, Java Spring Boot, JPA, MySQL, Capacitor, Docker, DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, GitHub CI/CD
positions.insights: Skills: Anguar · TypeScript · Java · Spring Boot · JPAS · Android · iOS · iOS Development · Android Development · Docker · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Stripe (Software)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built full-stack features for Orderly, a restaurant management platform for the foodservice industry, within a 40+ person engineering organization.
- BossTable: designed a reusable data table component that replaced one-off Angular table builds across 170+ screens. Developers pass a data array plus column and action definitions; new features (filtering, sorting, export, inline editing, row selection, column pinning) roll out to every screen at once.
- Led the design and build of a brand-new accounts payable and bank reconciliation system, giving customers their first way to match the general ledger to bank transactions, including Plaid integration, invoice creation, transaction matching, and payment processing.
- Delivered bank-reconciliation-to-invoice matching in 2–3 days against a 3-week estimate, with full backend test coverage and no major defects, using Claude for planning and multi-pass Claude/Copilot code review.
- Set standards for shared UI components and served as a primary reviewer, keeping the platform consistent and reducing duplication.
- 1,000+ commits of permission-aware features supporting multiple user roles and customer types.
Stack: Java, Spring Boot 4, Angular, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Java · Spring Framework · Software Design · Software Development · Generative AI Tools · AngularJS · MySQL · JPAS · Web Awesome Framework · Continuous Integration (CI)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contract role supporting The Home Depot's in-store payment systems.
- Enhanced the Java payment processing service architecture with improved logging and tracking of credit card payments
- Implemented updates for the OnGuard encryption upgrade supporting a company-wide PIN pad rollout
- Updated register-level Java Swing logic to capture and send newly required fields to back-end payment services
- Researched recurring production errors and wrote runbook documentation for resolution and escalation

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a payment consolidation system that settles multiple orders in a single transaction, saving ~$200K/year in processing fees
- Integrated 20–30 vendors' inventory systems through AWS services provisioned with Terraform, automating file drops and service calls
- Major contributor to the Open Cart ordering overhaul, adding a promotion system across ongoing purchases; delivered with 87% code coverage (JUnit, Cucumber). Shipped on time with strong customer reviews.
- Added a gift card payment type (purchase and redemption), integrating third-party vendors over REST and SOAP
- Designed and deployed Show Manager, a new live view of the current show's runbook timings and featured products for live TV production
- Revamped warehouse invoicing and packing for multi-order shipments, reducing shipping costs
- Built a rewards program REST API following payment industry standards for easy enterprise adoption
- Scrum team member releasing every 3–6 weeks; built Jenkins pipelines and maintained JIRA reporting
- Mentored 4 junior developers and interns
Stack: Java, Spring, JavaScript, Oracle PL/SQL, AWS, Terraform, Jenkins
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Git · Oracle Database · User Interface Design · RESTful WebServices · SQL · Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Reverse-engineered a legacy Adobe Flex/Sybase application and rebuilt it with AngularJS, Python, Node.js, and MS SQL Server, including a secure Python Tornado REST API and ad-hoc PDF/Excel reporting
- Rewrote a Scala/Spark GraphX pipeline for a large PubMed dataset in threaded Python and PySpark, producing the same author and citation graphs in a fraction of the time
- Managed client deliverables and milestones and mentored a junior developer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a secure service suite to CMS specifications connecting the SC Department of Health and Human Services with the Social Security Administration, IRS, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, and state Social Services for Medicaid eligibility verification; packaged for reuse by other state agencies
- Technical lead for Application Ingest, a grant-funded electronic Medicaid application system integrating a mainframe (IDMS/JDBC) and OnBase document management; led it through launch
- Automated daily, monthly, and quarterly reporting that replaced manual Excel work; tuned views and indexes for complex financial reports
- Spearheaded automated build and deployment infrastructure (Maven, Apache CXF); mentored team developers
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Oracle Database · User Interface Design · RESTful WebServices · SQL · Spring Boot

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Developed a Java-based web application to enhance the Change Request process for the entire Greenville MRO facility.  Utilized GWT with GXT (Ext-GWT) for front-end development, MS SQL Server database, and REST web services to create a context-driven flow for building a Change Request application.  Automated application workflows, approvals, and tracking through use of existing process documents and iterative user-driven development.  Organized a diverse team of users from around the business for weekly testing and discussion.  Documented the iterative development process used for future use within ITS&S. Released three production versions over nine months. Received Base Manager’s Recognition Award for Process Improvement and Lockheed STAR Award for first quarter of 2011.
	Maintained existing inventory management system.  Moved generated reporting from an older version of Crystal Reports (no longer licensed by the facility) to PDF and multiple versions of MS Office product outputs by utilizing the POI and iText libraries.  Upgraded to Office 2010 with minimal effort based on library extraction layer.
	Documented employee onboarding and standard setup procedures previously undocumented for future use.  Expanded based on additional onboarding experience from coworkers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a Java web application to automate the Change Request process for the Greenville MRO facility using GWT, MS SQL Server, and Apache POI.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Developed user requested web applications using PHP, Apache, and MySQL.  Created reusable email system to create and store templates of important emails and send them when needed. Email system is currently utilized by the university health center to send health alerts, among various other organizations. Created Java applications to merge nightly mainframe data queries with Oracle database tables.  Utilized Hibernate to store and retrieve records and Ant scripts to build the applications.

positions.title: Application Analyst
positions.description: Created a Health Alert System for University Health Center broadcast announcements using PHP, MySQL, and Apache.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a part of a new development team, helped to design and develop a system for collection and dissemination of geospatial-oriented products from various sources.  As a Senior Software Engineer, I was primarily responsible for the design and implementation of user interfaces, subscription management services, and data management services.
	Upon joining TCNI, initially tasked with and completed a two week prototype turn-around. Helped present prototype and proof of concept applications to customer in order to help secure funding.  Repeatedly tasked with demo setup and support in a rapid development cycle environment. 
	Using a Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) design, built a set of services for handling user requests for data and delivery of data packages to the user.  One service accepts and saves filtered user requests for various data types, determines what new data is available based on what has already been delivered to the user, and submits requests to the appropriate data processing services.  This same service requests metadata from various data stores for filtering products.  Another service picks up requested packages as they are dropped off, catalogs them, and sends notice to the user that a package is available for pick up.  Implemented use of a Web Feature Service (WFS) to allow geospatial filters of products.
	Built two user interfaces to provide user access.  A light-weight client, written utilizing JSPs, Servlets, and AJAX, provides basic subscription information, query functions, and package manifest and download capabilities.  This client only loads the requested information and the code is optimized to send the fewest number of bytes possible for low-bandwidth operations.  Using Google Web Toolkit (GWT), OpenLayers maps, and Servlets, a second client provides advanced filter and subscription functionality as well as discovery, status and package management tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilizing C++, developed new modules for an existing classified satellite image processing system.  Created a module for handling a new type of imagery, including verification of raw data, setting header data gathered from various sources, and compression and decompression algorithms.  Other modules included usage of new and modified Digital Image Processing algorithms for improved image feature detection.
	Received recognition award for new imagery type module completion well ahead of schedule.
Joined a team to develop a new system from an existing baseline for cataloging and disseminating satellite imagery from commercial source for use by Government agencies.  The NCDS portal provides a single catalog of filterable satellite imagery from multiple commercial sources that can be accessed by various entities in the Intelligence Community.  Once selected, imagery can be packaged for download, chipped (cropped) and enhanced.
	Primary responsibilities included updates and modifications to ingestion routines, updates to user interfaces, and creation of filters to separate sensitive data captures for alternate handling.  Modified ingestion routines to set metadata, determine imagery footprints, and synchronize catalogs from various data sources to the master catalog.  Updated user interfaces to include new filters. Added AJAX (JavaScript) calls to existing CGIs to allow automatic refresh of page when query results are returned.  Created custom polygons to geospatially filter data and flag images that fall on sensitive areas for limited distribution.
